#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
FINAL — Proper A0 vertical fill, refined spacing, museum-quality precision
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors — Lancet palette, refined
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_PANEL_LT = (36, 53, 72)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (26, 38, 53)

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1  # 3260

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

# Fonts — scaled for A0
f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)
f_table      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Helpers
def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)

def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")

def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")

def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)

def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)

def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)

def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# Background grid
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border
rect(0, 0, W, 3, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-3, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 3, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-3, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 38

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 105
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 130

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

# Study scope line
txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains, safety considerations,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5% PROSPECTIVE VALIDATION
# ============================================================
panel_h = 700
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 40

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 365

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 38
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 60

# Progress bar
bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 20
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 48

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 60

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY COMPARISON — FULL WIDTH, PROMINENT
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 62

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

# AI 87.5% — large, prominent
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 58

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 58

# Delta callout
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 450, y + 62, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 8, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 235, y + 16, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 90

# Specificity — smaller, full width
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)

txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 42
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 18
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 35

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN BREAKDOWN ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 56
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 65

# Table header
cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 32
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)
ly += 16

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),
    ("Dermatology",   "86.7%", "76.5%", "91.8%", "89.4%"),
    ("Ophthalmology", "90.1%", "82.3%", "95.2%", "93.7%"),
    ("Pathology",     "84.0%", "74.1%", "91.5%", "90.0%"),
]

for i, (d, a1, c1, a2, c2) in enumerate(domains):
    if i % 2 == 1:
        rect(COL1_X1, ly-4, COL1_X1+1030, ly+36, C_PANEL)
    # Mini bar for AI sensitivity
    bar_x = cx[1] + 80
    bar_w = 100
    hbar(bar_x, ly + 6, bar_w, 14, float(a1.replace('%',''))/100, C_TEAL, C_BAR_BG)
    # Mini bar for clinician sensitivity
    hbar(cx[2] + 80, ly + 6, bar_w, 14, float(c1.replace('%',''))/100, C_MUTED, C_BAR_BG)

    dot(cx[0]+6, ly+13, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[0]+18, ly, d, f_table, C_TEXT)
    txt(cx[1], ly, a1, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[2], ly, c1, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    txt(cx[3], ly, a2, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[4], ly, c2, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    ly += 48

ly += 30

# 32% turnaround callout
apanel(COL1_X1, ly, COL1_X2, ly + 88, C_TEAL, 5)
txt(COL1_X1 + 24, ly + 16, "32%", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 10, "reduction in diagnostic", f_body, C_TEXT)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 44, "turnaround time with AI assistance", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 120

left_end = ly

# --- RIGHT: SAFETY, BIAS & HEALTH EQUITY ---
ry = y

txt(COL2_X1, ry, "SAFETY, BIAS &", f_section, C_TEXT)
ry += 56
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "HEALTH EQUITY", f_section, C_WARN)
ry += 70

# 18% warning panel
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 340, C_WARN, 7)
ry += 28

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "18%", f_warn_num, C_WARN)
ry += 190

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "OF STUDIES ASSESSED FOR", f_body, C_TEXT)
ry += 34
txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "DEMOGRAPHIC BIAS", f_body_lg, C_WARN)
ry += 55

# Visual bar: 18% fill
hbar(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, COL2_W - 76, 16, 0.18, C_WARN, C_PANEL)
ry += 48

# Key findings
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "KEY FINDINGS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 42

findings = [
    "5–12 pp sensitivity disparities for underrepresented populations",
    "Dermatology AI trained on lighter skin tones showed largest gaps",
    "Adverse events in <1% of prospective trials — under-reporting suspected",
    "No standardised safety-reporting framework for AI-CDSS exists",
]

for f in findings:
    dot(COL2_X1 + 8, ry + 10, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(COL2_X1 + 28, ry, f, f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
    ry += 38

ry += 30

# Critical gap warning
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 118, C_WARN, 4)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 14, "CRITICAL GAP", f_mono_bold, C_WARN)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 44, "Absence of bias assessment in 82% of studies", f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 72, "undermines confidence in equitable AI deployment", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 148

right_end = ry

# Column divider
vline(COL1_X2 + COL_GAP//2, y + 118, max(left_end, right_end), C_DIVIDER, 1)

# ============================================================
# 5. IMPLEMENTATION GAP
# ============================================================
y = max(left_end, right_end) + 55

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 48

txt(CX1, y, "THE TRANSLATIONAL", f_section, C_TEXT)
y += 58
txt(CX1, y, "IMPLEMENTATION GAP", f_section, C_GOLD)
y += 72

# Two stat panels side by side
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 600, y + 80, C_GOLD, 5)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 14, "692", f_med_num, C_GOLD)
txt(CX1 + 155, y + 18, "FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)

apanel(CX1 + 640, y, CX1 + 1350, y + 80, C_WARN, 5)
txt(CX1 + 664, y + 14, "<5%", f_med_num, C_WARN)
txt(CX1 + 790, y + 18, "reach prospective clinical validation", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 115

# Visual pipeline diagram
dy = y
dh = 80
pipe_w = 700

# RESEARCH bar — full
rect(CX1, dy, CX1 + pipe_w, dy + dh, C_PANEL)
rect(CX1, dy, CX1 + pipe_w, dy + dh, C_TEAL_DK)
txt(CX1 + 25, dy + 22, "RESEARCH", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX1 + pipe_w - 20, dy + 26, "400+ published models", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)

# Gap
gap_x1 = CX1 + pipe_w + 25
gap_x2 = CX1 + pipe_w + 195
for gy in range(0, dh, 10):
    rect(gap_x1, dy + gy, gap_x2, dy + gy + 5, C_DARK)
txt_c((gap_x1 + gap_x2)//2, dy + 25, "GAP", f_mono_bold, C_GOLD)

rect(dep_x, dy, dep_x + 500, dy + dh, C_PANEL)

for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(barriers):
    rect(CX1, y + 3, CX1 + 34, y + 35, C_TEAL_DK)
    txt_c(CX1 + 17, y + 6, str(i+1), f_mono_bold, C_TEXT)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
FINAL — Proper A0 vertical fill, refined spacing, museum-quality precision
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors — Lancet palette, refined
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_PANEL_LT = (36, 53, 72)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (26, 38, 53)

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1  # 3260

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

# Fonts — scaled for A0
f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)
f_table      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Helpers
def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)

def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")

def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")

def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)

def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)

def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)

def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# Background grid
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border
rect(0, 0, W, 3, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-3, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 3, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-3, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 38

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 105
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 130

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

# Study scope line
txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains, safety considerations,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5% PROSPECTIVE VALIDATION
# ============================================================
panel_h = 700
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 40

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 365

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 38
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 60

# Progress bar
bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 20
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 48

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 60

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY COMPARISON — FULL WIDTH, PROMINENT
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 62

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

# AI 87.5% — large, prominent
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 58

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 58

# Delta callout
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 450, y + 62, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 8, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 235, y + 16, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 90

# Specificity — smaller, full width
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)

txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 42
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 18
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 35

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN BREAKDOWN ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 56
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 65

# Table header
cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 32
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)
ly += 16

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),
    ("Dermatology",   "86.7%", "76.5%", "91.8%", "89.4%"),
    ("Ophthalmology", "90.1%", "82.3%", "95.2%", "93.7%"),
    ("Pathology",     "84.0%", "74.1%", "91.5%", "90.0%"),
]

for i, (d, a1, c1, a2, c2) in enumerate(domains):
    if i % 2 == 1:
        rect(COL1_X1, ly-4, COL1_X1+1030, ly+36, C_PANEL)
    # Mini bar for AI sensitivity
    bar_x = cx[1] + 80
    bar_w = 100
    hbar(bar_x, ly + 6, bar_w, 14, float(a1.replace('%',''))/100, C_TEAL, C_BAR_BG)
    # Mini bar for clinician sensitivity
    hbar(cx[2] + 80, ly + 6, bar_w, 14, float(c1.replace('%',''))/100, C_MUTED, C_BAR_BG)

    dot(cx[0]+6, ly+13, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[0]+18, ly, d, f_table, C_TEXT)
    txt(cx[1], ly, a1, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[2], ly, c1, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    txt(cx[3], ly, a2, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[4], ly, c2, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    ly += 48

ly += 30

# 32% turnaround callout
apanel(COL1_X1, ly, COL1_X2, ly + 88, C_TEAL, 5)
txt(COL1_X1 + 24, ly + 16, "32%", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 10, "reduction in diagnostic", f_body, C_TEXT)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 44, "turnaround time with AI assistance", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 120

left_end = ly

# --- RIGHT: SAFETY, BIAS & HEALTH EQUITY ---
ry = y

txt(COL2_X1, ry, "SAFETY, BIAS &", f_section, C_TEXT)
ry += 56
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "HEALTH EQUITY", f_section, C_WARN)
ry += 70

# 18% warning panel
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 340, C_WARN, 7)
ry += 28

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "18%", f_warn_num, C_WARN)
ry += 190

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "OF STUDIES ASSESSED FOR", f_body, C_TEXT)
ry += 34
txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "DEMOGRAPHIC BIAS", f_body_lg, C_WARN)
ry += 55

# Visual bar: 18% fill
hbar(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, COL2_W - 76, 16, 0.18, C_WARN, C_PANEL)
ry += 48

# Key findings
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "KEY FINDINGS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 42

findings = [
    "5–12 pp sensitivity disparities for underrepresented populations",
    "Dermatology AI trained on lighter skin tones showed largest gaps",
    "Adverse events in <1% of prospective trials — under-reporting suspected",
    "No standardised safety-reporting framework for AI-CDSS exists",
]

for f in findings:
    dot(COL2_X1 + 8, ry + 10, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(COL2_X1 + 28, ry, f, f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
    ry += 38

ry += 30

# Critical gap warning
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 118, C_WARN, 4)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 14, "CRITICAL GAP", f_mono_bold, C_WARN)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 44, "Absence of bias assessment in 82% of studies", f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 72, "undermines confidence in equitable AI deployment", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 148

right_end = ry

# Column divider
vline(COL1_X2 + COL_GAP//2, y + 118, max(left_end, right_end), C_DIVIDER, 1)

# ============================================================
# 5. IMPLEMENTATION GAP
# ============================================================
y = max(left_end, right_end) + 55

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 48

txt(CX1, y, "THE TRANSLATIONAL", f_section, C_TEXT)
y += 58
txt(CX1, y, "IMPLEMENTATION GAP", f_section, C_GOLD)
y += 72

# Two stat panels side by side
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 600, y + 80, C_GOLD, 5)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 14, "692", f_med_num, C_GOLD)
txt(CX1 + 155, y + 18, "FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)

apanel(CX1 + 640, y, CX1 + 1350, y + 80, C_WARN, 5)
txt(CX1 + 664, y + 14, "<5%", f_med_num, C_WARN)
txt(CX1 + 790, y + 18, "reach prospective clinical validation", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 115

# Visual pipeline diagram
dy = y
dh = 80
pipe_w = 700

# RESEARCH bar — full
rect(CX1, dy, CX1 + pipe_w, dy + dh, C_PANEL)
rect(CX1, dy, CX1 + pipe_w, dy + dh, C_TEAL_DK)
txt(CX1 + 25, dy + 22, "RESEARCH", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX1 + pipe_w - 20, dy + 26, "400+ published models", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)

# Gap
gap_x1 = CX1 + pipe_w + 25
gap_x2 = CX1 + pipe_w + 195
for gy in range(0, dh, 10):
    rect(gap_x1, dy + gy, gap_x2, dy + gy + 5, C_DARK)
txt_c((gap_x1 + gap_x2)//2, dy + 25, "GAP", f_mono_bold, C_GOLD)

# DEPLOYMENT bar — tiny fill
dep_x = gap_x2 + 25
rect(dep_x, dy, dep_x + 500, dy + dh, C_PANEL)
rect(dep_x, dy, dep_x + int(500 * 0.05), dy + dh, C_GOLD_DK)
txt(dep_x + 25, dy + 22, "DEPLOYMENT", f_body, C_GOLD)
txt_r(dep_x + 480, dy + 26, "<5% validated", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)

y += dh + 60

# Barriers
txt(CX1, y, "Key barriers to clinical deployment:", f_body, C_TEXT)
y += 48

barriers = [
    ("Data infrastructure", "Fragmented EHR systems; lack of interoperability standards"),
    ("Regulatory uncertainty", "Evolving frameworks that lag behind the pace of AI development"),
    ("Clinician trust", "Insufficient explainability and transparency of model outputs"),
    ("Economic evidence", "Limited cost-effectiveness analyses for health-system investment"),
    ("Workflow integration", "Poor alignment of AI tools with existing clinical workflows"),
]

for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(barriers):
    rect(CX1, y + 3, CX1 + 34, y + 35, C_TEAL_DK)
    txt_c(CX1 + 17, y + 6, str(i+1), f_mono_bold, C_TEXT)
    txt(CX1 + 52, y, title, f_barrier_t, C_TEXT)
    txt(CX1 + 52, y + 32, desc, f_barrier_d, C_SUBTLE)
    y += 78

y += 30

# ============================================================
# 6. RECOMMENDATIONS
# ============================================================
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 48

txt(CX1, y, "RECOMMENDATIONS &", f_section, C_TEXT)
y += 58
txt(CX1, y, "FUTURE DIRECTIONS", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 68

recommendations = [
    ("Mandate prospective validation", "including multi-site and diverse-population trials before deployment"),
    ("Standardise bias auditing", "with demographic-stratified performance reporting as a publication requirement"),
    ("Develop shared safety-reporting registries", "analogous to pharmacovigilance systems for AI-CDSS"),
    ("Invest in interoperability", "through adoption of open data standards (FHIR, OMOP)"),
    ("Prioritise explainability research", "to build clinician and patient trust in AI-augmented care"),
]

rec_l = CX1
rec_r = CX1 + CW//2 + 60

for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(recommendations):
    if i < 3:
        rx = rec_l
        ry_r = y + i * 95
    else:
        rx = rec_r
        ry_r = y + (i - 3) * 95

    draw.ellipse([(rx, ry_r + 3), (rx + 34, ry_r + 37)], outline=C_TEAL, width=2)
    txt_c(rx + 17, ry_r + 7, str(i+1), f_mono_bold, C_TEAL)

    txt(rx + 50, ry_r, title, f_rec_bold, C_TEXT)
    txt(rx + 50, ry_r + 32, desc, f_rec_body, C_SUBTLE)

y += 3 * 95 + 40

# ============================================================
# 7. CLOSING
# ============================================================
y += 25
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 40

rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + 100, C_PANEL)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 5, y + 100, C_TEAL)
y += 18

closing = "Closing the gap between AI research promise and clinical reality requires coordinated action across the research, regulatory, and healthcare delivery ecosystem."
txt(CX1 + 28, y, closing, f_closing, C_TEXT)
y += 65

# ============================================================
# 8. FOOTER
# ============================================================
fy = H - MB - 55
hline(fy, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
fy += 20

ref = "Source: Systematic review of >400 studies, The Lancet Digital Health (2023)   ·   FDA AI/ML Medical Device Database (2023)"
txt(CX1, fy, ref, f_footer, C_SUBTLE)

hline(H - MB, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)

# Save
out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Saved: {out}  [{W}×{H}]")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
FINAL — Proper A0 vertical fill, refined spacing, museum-quality precision
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors — Lancet palette, refined
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_PANEL_LT = (36, 53, 72)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (26, 38, 53)

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1  # 3260

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

# Fonts — scaled for A0
f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)
f_table      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Helpers
def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)

def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")

def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")

def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)

def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)

def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)

def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# Background grid
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border
rect(0, 0, W, 3, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-3, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 3, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-3, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 38

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 105
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 130

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

# Study scope line
txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains, safety considerations,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5% PROSPECTIVE VALIDATION
# ============================================================
panel_h = 700
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 40

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 365

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 38
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 60

# Progress bar
bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 20
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 48

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 60

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY COMPARISON — FULL WIDTH, PROMINENT
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 62

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

# AI 87.5% — large, prominent
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 58

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 58

# Delta callout
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 450, y + 62, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 8, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 235, y + 16, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 90

# Specificity — smaller, full width
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)

txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 42
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 18
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 35

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN BREAKDOWN ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 56
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 65

# Table header
cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 32
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)
ly += 16

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),
    ("Dermatology",   "86.7%", "76.5%", "91.8%", "89.4%"),
    ("Ophthalmology", "90.1%", "82.3%", "95.2%", "93.7%"),
    ("Pathology",     "84.0%", "74.1%", "91.5%", "90.0%"),
]

for i, (d, a1, c1, a2, c2) in enumerate(domains):
    if i % 2 == 1:
        rect(COL1_X1, ly-4, COL1_X1+1030, ly+36, C_PANEL)
    # Mini bar for AI sensitivity
    bar_x = cx[1] + 80
    bar_w = 100
    hbar(bar_x, ly + 6, bar_w, 14, float(a1.replace('%',''))/100, C_TEAL, C_BAR_BG)
    # Mini bar for clinician sensitivity
    hbar(cx[2] + 80, ly + 6, bar_w, 14, float(c1.replace('%',''))/100, C_MUTED, C_BAR_BG)

    dot(cx[0]+6, ly+13, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[0]+18, ly, d, f_table, C_TEXT)
    txt(cx[1], ly, a1, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[2], ly, c1, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    txt(cx[3], ly, a2, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[4], ly, c2, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    ly += 48

ly += 30

# 32% turnaround callout
apanel(COL1_X1, ly, COL1_X2, ly + 88, C_TEAL, 5)
txt(COL1_X1 + 24, ly + 16, "32%", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 10, "reduction in diagnostic", f_body, C_TEXT)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 44, "turnaround time with AI assistance", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 120

left_end = ly

# --- RIGHT: SAFETY, BIAS & HEALTH EQUITY ---
ry = y

txt(COL2_X1, ry, "SAFETY, BIAS &", f_section, C_TEXT)
ry += 56
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "HEALTH EQUITY", f_section, C_WARN)
ry += 70

# 18% warning panel
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 340, C_WARN, 7)
ry += 28

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "18%", f_warn_num, C_WARN)
ry += 190

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "OF STUDIES ASSESSED FOR", f_body, C_TEXT)
ry += 34
txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "DEMOGRAPHIC BIAS", f_body_lg, C_WARN)

# Visual bar: 18% fill

ry += 48

# Key findings
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "KEY FINDINGS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 42

findings = [

for f in findings:

txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 44, "Absence of bias assessment in 82% of studies", f_body_sm, C_TEXT)

ry += 148

right_end = ry

# Column divider
vline(COL1_X2 + COL_GAP//2, y + 118, max(left_end, right_end), C_DIVIDER, 1)

    ("Prioritise explainability research", "to build clinician and patient trust in AI-augmented care"),
]

rec_l = CX1
rec_r = CX1 + CW//2 + 60

for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(recommendations):

        rx = rec_l
        ry_r = y + i * 95
    else:
        rx = rec_r
        ry_r = y + (i - 3) * 95

    draw.ellipse([(rx, ry_r + 3), (rx + 34, ry_r + 37)], outline=C_TEAL, width=2)
    txt_c(rx + 17, ry_r + 7, str(i+1), f_mono_bold, C_TEAL)

    txt(rx + 50, ry_r, title, f_rec_bold, C_TEXT)
    txt(rx + 50, ry_r + 32, desc, f_rec_body, C_SUBTLE)

y += 3 * 95 + 40

# ============================================================
# 7. CLOSING
# ============================================================
y += 25
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 40

rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + 100, C_PANEL)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 5, y + 100, C_TEAL)
y += 18

closing = "Closing the gap between AI research promise and clinical reality requires coordinated action across the research, regulatory, and healthcare delivery ecosystem."
txt(CX1 + 28, y, closing, f_closing, C_TEXT)
y += 65

# ============================================================
# 8. FOOTER
# ============================================================
fy = H - MB - 55
hline(fy, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
fy += 20

ref = "Source: Systematic review of >400 studies, The Lancet Digital Health (2023)   ·   FDA AI/ML Medical Device Database (2023)"
txt(CX1, fy, ref, f_footer, C_SUBTLE)

hline(H - MB, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)

# Save
out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Saved: {out}  [{W}×{H}]")

raw_arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
FINAL — Proper A0 vertical fill, refined spacing, museum-quality precision
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors — Lancet palette, refined
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_PANEL_LT = (36, 53, 72)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (26, 38, 53)

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1  # 3260

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

# Fonts — scaled for A0
f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)
f_table      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Helpers
def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)

def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")

def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")

def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)

def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)

def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)

def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# Background grid
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border
rect(0, 0, W, 3, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-3, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 3, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-3, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 38

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 105
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 130

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

# Study scope line
txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains, safety considerations,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5% PROSPECTIVE VALIDATION
# ============================================================
panel_h = 700
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 40

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 365

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 38
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 60

# Progress bar
bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 20
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 48

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 60

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY COMPARISON — FULL WIDTH, PROMINENT
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 62

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

# AI 87.5% — large, prominent
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 58

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 58

# Delta callout
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 450, y + 62, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 8, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 235, y + 16, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 90

# Specificity — smaller, full width
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)

txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 42
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 18
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 35

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN BREAKDOWN ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 56
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 65

# Table header
cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 32
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)
ly += 16

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),
    ("Dermatology",   "86.7%", "76.5%", "91.8%", "89.4%"),
    ("Ophthalmology", "90.1%", "82.3%", "95.2%", "93.7%"),
    ("Pathology",     "84.0%", "74.1%", "91.5%", "90.0%"),
]

for i, (d, a1, c1, a2, c2) in enumerate(domains):
    if i % 2 == 1:
        rect(COL1_X1, ly-4, COL1_X1+1030, ly+36, C_PANEL)
    # Mini bar for AI sensitivity
    bar_x = cx[1] + 80
    bar_w = 100
    hbar(bar_x, ly + 6, bar_w, 14, float(a1.replace('%',''))/100, C_TEAL, C_BAR_BG)
    # Mini bar for clinician sensitivity
    hbar(cx[2] + 80, ly + 6, bar_w, 14, float(c1.replace('%',''))/100, C_MUTED, C_BAR_BG)

    dot(cx[0]+6, ly+13, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[0]+18, ly, d, f_table, C_TEXT)
    txt(cx[1], ly, a1, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[2], ly, c1, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    txt(cx[3], ly, a2, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[4], ly, c2, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    ly += 48

ly += 30

# 32% turnaround callout
apanel(COL1_X1, ly, COL1_X2, ly + 88, C_TEAL, 5)
txt(COL1_X1 + 24, ly + 16, "32%", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 10, "reduction in diagnostic", f_body, C_TEXT)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 44, "turnaround time with AI assistance", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 120

left_end = ly

# --- RIGHT: SAFETY, BIAS & HEALTH EQUITY ---
ry = y

txt(COL2_X1, ry, "SAFETY, BIAS &", f_section, C_TEXT)
ry += 56
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "HEALTH EQUITY", f_section, C_WARN)
ry += 70

# 18% warning panel
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 340, C_WARN, 7)
ry += 28

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "18%", f_warn_num, C_WARN)
ry += 190

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "OF STUDIES ASSESSED FOR", f_body, C_TEXT)
ry += 34
txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "DEMOGRAPHIC BIAS", f_body_lg, C_WARN)
ry += 55

# Visual bar: 18% fill
hbar(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, COL2_W - 76, 16, 0.18, C_WARN, C_PANEL)
ry += 48

# Key findings
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "KEY FINDINGS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 42

findings = [
    "5–12 pp sensitivity disparities for underrepresented populations",
    "Dermatology AI trained on lighter skin tones showed largest gaps",
    "Adverse events in <1% of prospective trials — under-reporting suspected",
    "No standardised safety-reporting framework for AI-CDSS exists",
]

for f in findings:
    dot(COL2_X1 + 8, ry + 10, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(COL2_X1 + 28, ry, f, f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
    ry += 38

ry += 30

# Critical gap warning
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 118, C_WARN, 4)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 14, "CRITICAL GAP", f_mono_bold, C_WARN)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 44, "Absence of bias assessment in 82% of studies", f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 72, "undermines confidence in equitable AI deployment", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 148

right_end = ry

# Column divider
vline(COL1_X2 + COL_GAP//2, y + 118, max(left_end, right_end), C_DIVIDER, 1)

# ============================================================
# 5. IMPLEMENTATION GAP
# ============================================================
y = max(left_end, right_end) + 55

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 48

txt(CX1, y, "THE TRANSLATIONAL", f_section, C_TEXT)
y += 58
txt(CX1, y, "IMPLEMENTATION GAP", f_section, C_GOLD)
y += 72

# Two stat panels side by side
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 600, y + 80, C_GOLD, 5)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 14, "692", f_med_num, C_GOLD)
txt(CX1 + 155, y + 18, "FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)

apanel(CX1 + 640, y, CX1 + 1350, y + 80, C_WARN, 5)
txt(CX1 + 664, y + 14, "<5%", f_med_num, C_WARN)
txt(CX1 + 790, y + 18, "reach prospective clinical validation", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 115

# Visual pipeline diagram
dy = y
dh = 80
pipe_w = 700

# RESEARCH bar — full
rect(CX1, dy, CX1 + pipe_w, dy + dh, C_PANEL)
rect(CX1, dy, CX1 + pipe_w, dy + dh, C_TEAL_DK)
txt(CX1 + 25, dy + 22, "RESEARCH", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX1 + pipe_w - 20, dy + 26, "400+ published models", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)

# Gap
gap_x1 = CX1 + pipe_w + 25
gap_x2 = CX1 + pipe_w + 195
for gy in range(0, dh, 10):
    rect(gap_x1, dy + gy, gap_x2, dy + gy + 5, C_DARK)
txt_c((gap_x1 + gap_x2)//2, dy + 25, "GAP", f_mono_bold, C_GOLD)

# DEPLOYMENT bar — tiny fill
dep_x = gap_x2 + 25
rect(dep_x, dy, dep_x + 500, dy + dh, C_PANEL)
rect(dep_x, dy, dep_x + int(500 * 0.05), dy + dh, C_GOLD_DK)
txt(dep_x + 25, dy + 22, "DEPLOYMENT", f_body, C_GOLD)

y += dh + 60

# Barriers
txt(CX1, y, "Key barriers to clinical deployment:", f_body, C_TEXT)
y += 48

barriers = [
    ("Data infrastructure", "Fragmented EHR systems; lack of interoperability standards"),
    ("Regulatory uncertainty", "Evolving frameworks that lag behind the pace of AI development"),
    ("Clinician trust", "Insufficient explainability and transparency of model outputs"),
    ("Economic evidence", "Limited cost-effectiveness analyses for health-system investment"),
    ("Workflow integration", "Poor alignment of AI tools with existing clinical workflows"),
]

for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(barriers):
    rect(CX1, y + 3, CX1 + 34, y + 35, C_TEAL_DK)
    txt_c(CX1 + 17, y + 6, str(i+1), f_mono_bold, C_TEXT)
    txt(CX1 + 52, y, title, f_barrier_t, C_TEXT)
    txt(CX1 + 52, y + 32, desc, f_barrier_d, C_SUBTLE)
    y += 78

y += 30

# ============================================================
# 6. RECOMMENDATIONS
# ============================================================
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 48

txt(CX1, y, "RECOMMENDATIONS &", f_section, C_TEXT)
y += 58
txt(CX1, y, "FUTURE DIRECTIONS", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 68

recommendations = [
    ("Mandate prospective validation", "including multi-site and diverse-population trials before deployment"),
    ("Standardise bias auditing", "with demographic-stratified performance reporting as a publication requirement"),
    ("Develop shared safety-reporting registries", "analogous to pharmacovigilance systems for AI-CDSS"),
    ("Invest in interoperability", "through adoption of open data standards (FHIR, OMOP)"),
    ("Prioritise explainability research", "to build clinician and patient trust in AI-augmented care"),
]

rec_l = CX1
rec_r = CX1 + CW//2 + 60

for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(recommendations):
    if i < 3:
        rx = rec_l
        ry_r = y + i * 95
    else:
        rx = rec_r
        ry_r = y + (i - 3) * 95

    draw.ellipse([(rx, ry_r + 3), (rx + 34, ry_r + 37)], outline=C_TEAL, width=2)
    txt_c(rx + 17, ry_r + 7, str(i+1), f_mono_bold, C_TEAL)

    txt(rx + 50, ry_r, title, f_rec_bold, C_TEXT)
    txt(rx + 50, ry_r + 32, desc, f_rec_body, C_SUBTLE)

y += 3 * 95 + 40

# ============================================================
# 7. CLOSING
# ============================================================
y += 25
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 40

rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + 100, C_PANEL)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 5, y + 100, C_TEAL)
y += 18

closing = "Closing the gap between AI research promise and clinical reality requires coordinated action across the research, regulatory, and healthcare delivery ecosystem."
txt(CX1 + 28, y, closing, f_closing, C_TEXT)
y += 65

# ============================================================
# 8. FOOTER
# ============================================================
fy = H - MB - 55
hline(fy, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
fy += 20

ref = "Source: Systematic review of >400 studies, The Lancet Digital Health (2023)   ·   FDA AI/ML Medical Device Database (2023)"
txt(CX1, fy, ref, f_footer, C_SUBTLE)

hline(H - MB, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)

# Save
out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Saved: {out}  [{W}×{H}]")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
FINAL REFINED — museum-quality precision, no clutter, every element earns its place
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors — Lancet palette, precisely calibrated
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (25, 37, 51)     # nearly invisible grid

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

# Fonts
f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)
f_table      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Helpers
def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)

def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")

def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")

def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)

def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)

def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)

def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# ============================================================
# BACKGROUND — barely-there grid, like graph paper in a lab notebook
# ============================================================
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border — thin, precise, clinical
rect(0, 0, W, 2, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-2, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 2, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-2, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 38

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 105
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 130

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

# Study scope
txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 27
txt(CX1, y, "safety considerations, and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 48

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5%
# ============================================================
panel_h = 700
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 40

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 365

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 38
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 60

# The devastating 5% bar
bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 20
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 48

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 60

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY — FULL WIDTH, PROMINENT
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 62

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

# AI 87.5%
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 58

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 58

# Delta callout
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 450, y + 62, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 8, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 235, y + 16, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 90

# Specificity — compact, single line
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 42
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 18
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 40

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN TABLE ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 56
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 65

# Table header
cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 32
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)
ly += 16

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),
    ("Dermatology",   "86.7%", "76.5%", "91.8%", "89.4%"),
    ("Ophthalmology", "90.1%", "82.3%", "95.2%", "93.7%"),
    ("Pathology",     "84.0%", "74.1%", "91.5%", "90.0%"),
]

for i, (d, a1, c1, a2, c2) in enumerate(domains):
    if i % 2 == 1:
        rect(COL1_X1, ly-4, COL1_X1+1030, ly+36, C_PANEL)
    dot(cx[0]+6, ly+13, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[0]+18, ly, d, f_table, C_TEXT)
    txt(cx[1], ly, a1, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[2], ly, c1, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    txt(cx[3], ly, a2, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[4], ly, c2, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    ly += 48

ly += 30

# 32% turnaround callout
apanel(COL1_X1, ly, COL1_X2, ly + 88, C_TEAL, 5)
txt(COL1_X1 + 24, ly + 16, "32%", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 10, "reduction in diagnostic", f_body, C_TEXT)
txt(COL1_X1 + 155, ly + 44, "turnaround time with AI assistance", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 120

left_end = ly

# --- RIGHT: SAFETY, BIAS & HEALTH EQUITY ---
ry = y

txt(COL2_X1, ry, "SAFETY, BIAS &", f_section, C_TEXT)
ry += 56
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "HEALTH EQUITY", f_section, C_WARN)
ry += 70

# 18% warning panel
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 340, C_WARN, 7)
ry += 28

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "18%", f_warn_num, C_WARN)
ry += 190

txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "OF STUDIES ASSESSED FOR", f_body, C_TEXT)
ry += 34
txt(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, "DEMOGRAPHIC BIAS", f_body_lg, C_WARN)
ry += 55

# 18% bar
hbar(COL2_X1 + 38, ry, COL2_W - 76, 16, 0.18, C_WARN, C_PANEL)
ry += 48

# Key findings
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "KEY FINDINGS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 42

findings = [
    "5–12 pp sensitivity disparities for underrepresented populations",
    "Dermatology AI trained on lighter skin tones showed largest gaps",
    "Adverse events in <1% of prospective trials — under-reporting suspected",
    "No standardised safety-reporting framework for AI-CDSS exists",
]

for f in findings:
    dot(COL2_X1 + 8, ry + 10, 3, C_TEAL)

        rx = rec_r
        ry_r = y + (i - 3) * 95

    draw.ellipse([(rx, ry_r + 3), (rx + 34, ry_r + 37)], outline=C_TEAL, width=2)

    txt(rx + 50, ry_r + 32, desc, f_rec_body, C_SUBTLE)

y += 3 * 95 + 40

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)

rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 5, y + 100, C_TEAL)

txt(CX1 + 28, y, closing, f_closing, C_TEXT)
y += 65

txt(CX1, fy, ref, f_footer, C_SUBTLE)

hline(H - MB, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)

# Save
out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Saved: {out}  [{W}×{H}]")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
FINAL REFINED — museum-quality precision, no clutter, every element earns its place
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors — Lancet palette, precisely calibrated
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (25, 37, 51)     # nearly invisible grid

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

# Fonts
f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)
f_table      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Helpers
def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)

def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")

def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")

def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)

def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)

def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)

def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# ============================================================
# BACKGROUND — barely-there grid, like graph paper in a lab notebook
# ============================================================
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border — thin, precise, clinical
rect(0, 0, W, 2, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-2, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 2, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-2, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 38

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 105
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 130

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

# Study scope
txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 27
txt(CX1, y, "safety considerations, and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 48

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5%
# ============================================================
panel_h = 700
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 40

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 365

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 38
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 60

# The devastating 5% bar
bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 20
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 48

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 60

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY — FULL WIDTH, PROMINENT
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 62

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50

# AI 87.5%
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 58

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 58
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 36, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 58

# Delta callout
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 450, y + 62, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 8, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 235, y + 16, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 90

# Specificity — compact, single line
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 42
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 18
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 12, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 40

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN TABLE ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 56
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 65

# Table header
cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 32
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)
ly += 16

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),
    ("Dermatology",   "86.7%", "76.5%", "91.8%", "89.4%"),
    ("Ophthalmology", "90.1%", "82.3%", "95.2%", "93.7%"),
    ("Pathology",     "84.0%", "74.1%", "91.5%", "90.0%"),
]

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")

    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")

    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)

"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors — Lancet palette, precisely calibrated
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (25, 37, 51)     # nearly invisible grid

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

# Fonts
f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)

f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)

f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Helpers
def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)

def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")

def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")

def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)

def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)

def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)

def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]

rect(0, 0, 2, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================

rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 40

t = "< 5 %"

ay += 365

bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 20

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 62

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)

# AI 87.5%

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
PRISTINE — Full A0 fill, single-column recommendations, refined spacing
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (25, 37, 51)

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)
f_table      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_metric_val = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_metric_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 17)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)
def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")
def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")
def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)
def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)
def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)
def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)
def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)
def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]
def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# Background grid
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border
rect(0, 0, W, 2, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-2, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 2, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-2, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 40

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 108
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 135
