#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
PRISTINE — Full A0 fill, single-column recommendations, refined spacing
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (25, 37, 51)

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)
f_table      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_metric_val = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_metric_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 17)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)
def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")
def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")
def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)
def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)
def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)
def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)
def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)
def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]
def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# Background grid
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border
rect(0, 0, W, 2, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-2, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 2, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-2, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 40

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 108
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 135

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "safety considerations, and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 55

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5%
# ============================================================
panel_h = 720
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 45

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 370

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 40
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 65

bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 22
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 55

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 65

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY — FULL WIDTH
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 65

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

# AI 87.5%
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 62
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 38, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 62

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 62
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 38, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 62

# Delta
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 460, y + 64, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 10, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 240, y + 18, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 95

# Specificity
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 30
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 44
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 14, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 20
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 14, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 45

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 55

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN TABLE ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 58
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 70

cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 34
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)
ly += 18

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),
    ("Dermatology",   "86.7%", "76.5%", "91.8%", "89.4%"),
    ("Ophthalmology", "90.1%", "82.3%", "95.2%", "93.7%"),
    ("Pathology",     "84.0%", "74.1%", "91.5%", "90.0%"),
]

for i, (d, a1, c1, a2, c2) in enumerate(domains):
    if i % 2 == 1:
        rect(COL1_X1, ly-4, COL1_X1+1030, ly+38, C_PANEL)
    dot(cx[0]+6, ly+14, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[0]+18, ly, d, f_table, C_TEXT)
    txt(cx[1], ly, a1, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[2], ly, c1, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    txt(cx[3], ly, a2, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[4], ly, c2, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    ly += 50

ly += 35

# 32% turnaround
apanel(COL1_X1, ly, COL1_X2, ly + 92, C_TEAL, 5)
txt(COL1_X1 + 24, ly + 18, "32%", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(COL1_X1 + 160, ly + 12, "reduction in diagnostic", f_body, C_TEXT)
txt(COL1_X1 + 160, ly + 46, "turnaround time with AI assistance", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 128

left_end = ly

# --- RIGHT: SAFETY ---
ry = y

txt(COL2_X1, ry, "SAFETY, BIAS &", f_section, C_TEXT)
ry += 58
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "HEALTH EQUITY", f_section, C_WARN)
ry += 74

# 18% panel
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 350, C_WARN, 7)
ry += 30

txt(COL2_X1 + 40, ry, "18%", f_warn_num, C_WARN)
ry += 195

txt(COL2_X1 + 40, ry, "OF STUDIES ASSESSED FOR", f_body, C_TEXT)
ry += 36
txt(COL2_X1 + 40, ry, "DEMOGRAPHIC BIAS", f_body_lg, C_WARN)
ry += 60

hbar(COL2_X1 + 40, ry, COL2_W - 80, 18, 0.18, C_WARN, C_PANEL)
ry += 52

# Key findings
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "KEY FINDINGS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 44

findings = [
    "5–12 pp sensitivity disparities for underrepresented populations",
    "Dermatology AI trained on lighter skin tones showed largest gaps",
    "Adverse events in <1% of prospective trials — under-reporting suspected",
    "No standardised safety-reporting framework for AI-CDSS exists",
]

for f in findings:
    dot(COL2_X1 + 8, ry + 11, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(COL2_X1 + 28, ry, f, f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
    ry += 42

ry += 35

# Critical gap
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 125, C_WARN, 4)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 16, "CRITICAL GAP", f_mono_bold, C_WARN)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 48, "Absence of bias assessment in 82% of studies", f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 78, "undermines confidence in equitable AI deployment", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 158

right_end = ry

# Column divider
vline(COL1_X2 + COL_GAP//2, y + 120, max(left_end, right_end), C_DIVIDER, 1)

# ============================================================
# 5. IMPLEMENTATION GAP
# ============================================================
y = max(left_end, right_end) + 60

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 50

txt(CX1, y, "THE TRANSLATIONAL", f_section, C_TEXT)
y += 60
txt(CX1, y, "IMPLEMENTATION GAP", f_section, C_GOLD)
y += 78

# Two stat panels
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 620, y + 84, C_GOLD, 5)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 16, "692", f_med_num, C_GOLD)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
PRISTINE — Full A0 fill, single-column recommendations, refined spacing
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (25, 37, 51)

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_warn_num   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 170)

f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_metric_val = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_metric_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 17)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)
def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")
def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")
def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)
def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)
def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)
def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)
def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)
def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]
def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):
    draw.ellipse([(x-r, y-r), (x+r, y+r)], fill=c)

# Background grid
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):
    vline(gx, MT, H-MB, C_GRID, 1)
for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):
    hline(gy, ML, CX2, C_GRID, 1)

# Border
rect(0, 0, W, 2, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-2, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 2, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-2, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)
y += 40

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 108
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 135

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "safety considerations, and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 55

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5%
# ============================================================
panel_h = 720
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 45

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 370

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 40
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 65

bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 22
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 55

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 65

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY — FULL WIDTH
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 65

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

# AI 87.5%
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 62
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 38, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 62

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 62
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 38, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 62

# Delta
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 460, y + 64, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 10, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 240, y + 18, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 95

# Specificity
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 30
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 44
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 14, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 20
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 14, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 45

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 55

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN TABLE ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 58
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 70

cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 34
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)
ly += 18

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),
    ("Dermatology",   "86.7%", "76.5%", "91.8%", "89.4%"),
    ("Ophthalmology", "90.1%", "82.3%", "95.2%", "93.7%"),
    ("Pathology",     "84.0%", "74.1%", "91.5%", "90.0%"),
]

for i, (d, a1, c1, a2, c2) in enumerate(domains):
    if i % 2 == 1:
        rect(COL1_X1, ly-4, COL1_X1+1030, ly+38, C_PANEL)
    dot(cx[0]+6, ly+14, 3, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[0]+18, ly, d, f_table, C_TEXT)
    txt(cx[1], ly, a1, f_table_num, C_TEAL)
    txt(cx[2], ly, c1, f_table_num, C_SUBTLE)
    txt(cx[3], ly, a2, f_table_num, C_TEAL)

ly += 35

# 32% turnaround
apanel(COL1_X1, ly, COL1_X2, ly + 92, C_TEAL, 5)

txt(COL1_X1 + 160, ly + 12, "reduction in diagnostic", f_body, C_TEXT)

ly += 128

left_end = ly

apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 350, C_WARN, 7)

ry += 52

# Key findings
txt(COL2_X1, ry, "KEY FINDINGS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 44

findings = [
    "5–12 pp sensitivity disparities for underrepresented populations",
    "Dermatology AI trained on lighter skin tones showed largest gaps",

for f in findings:

ry += 35

# Critical gap
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 125, C_WARN, 4)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 16, "CRITICAL GAP", f_mono_bold, C_WARN)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 48, "Absence of bias assessment in 82% of studies", f_body_sm, C_TEXT)
txt(COL2_X1 + 22, ry + 78, "undermines confidence in equitable AI deployment", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
ry += 158

right_end = ry

# Column divider
vline(COL1_X2 + COL_GAP//2, y + 120, max(left_end, right_end), C_DIVIDER, 1)

# ============================================================

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic Conference Poster: AI in Clinical Decision-Making
Design Philosophy: Evidential Form
PRISTINE — Full A0 fill, single-column recommendations, refined spacing

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3600, 5091
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# Colors
C_BG       = (24, 36, 50)
C_PANEL    = (30, 45, 62)
C_TEXT     = (237, 240, 245)
C_TEAL     = (52, 180, 174)
C_TEAL_DK  = (38, 132, 128)
C_GOLD     = (200, 167, 70)
C_GOLD_DK  = (150, 125, 52)
C_WARN     = (215, 80, 74)
C_WARN_DK  = (155, 58, 54)
C_SUBTLE   = (120, 140, 165)
C_MUTED    = (72, 105, 130)
C_BAR_BG   = (38, 55, 75)
C_DARK     = (18, 27, 39)
C_DIVIDER  = (42, 60, 80)
C_GRID     = (25, 37, 51)

ML, MR, MT, MB = 170, 170, 160, 120
CX1, CX2 = ML, W - MR
CW = CX2 - CX1

COL_GAP = 100
HALF = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2
COL1_X1, COL1_X2 = ML, ML + HALF
COL2_X1, COL2_X2 = COL1_X2 + COL_GAP, CX2
COL1_W, COL2_W = COL1_X2 - COL1_X1, COL2_X2 - COL2_X1

def lf(n, s):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, n), s)

f_conf       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_title      = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 82)
f_subtitle   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_section    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf", 44)
f_body       = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_body_sm    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_body_lg    = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 30)
f_mono       = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 21)
f_mono_bold  = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 23)
f_anchor     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 340)
f_anchor_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 27)
f_big_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 78)
f_med_num    = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 54)
f_sm_num     = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 36)

f_table_hd   = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 21)
f_table_num  = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 26)
f_rec_bold   = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
f_rec_body   = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_barrier_t  = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)
f_barrier_d  = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
f_footer     = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
f_closing    = lf("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 28)
f_scope      = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)
f_metric_val = lf("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 40)
f_metric_lbl = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 17)

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), C_BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def txt(x, y, t, f, c, a="la"):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor=a)
def txt_c(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ma")
def txt_r(x, y, t, f, c):
    draw.text((x, y), t, font=f, fill=c, anchor="ra")
def hline(y, x1=CX1, x2=CX2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)
def vline(x, y1, y2, c=C_DIVIDER, w=1):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)
def rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, c):
    draw.rectangle([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=c)
def hbar(x, y, w, h, pct, fill, bg=C_BAR_BG):
    rect(x, y, x+w, y+h, bg)
    fw = max(2, int(w * pct))
    rect(x, y, x+fw, y+h, fill)
def apanel(x1, y1, x2, y2, ac, aw=5):
    rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, C_PANEL)
    rect(x1, y1, x1+aw, y2, ac)
def tw(t, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0]
def dot(x, y, r=4, c=C_TEAL):

# Background grid
for gx in range(ML, CX2+1, 100):

for gy in range(MT, H-MB+1, 100):

# Border
rect(0, 0, W, 2, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, H-2, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(0, 0, 2, H, C_TEAL_DK)
rect(W-2, 0, W, H, C_TEAL_DK)

# ============================================================
# 1. HEADER
# ============================================================
y = MT

txt(CX1, y, "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM  ·  2023", f_conf, C_SUBTLE)
y += 50
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_TEAL, 2)

txt(CX1, y, "Artificial Intelligence in", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 108
txt(CX1, y, "Clinical Decision-Making", f_title, C_TEXT)
y += 135

txt(CX1, y, "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps", f_subtitle, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

txt(CX1, y, "A synthesis of current evidence on AI-assisted clinical decision support — diagnostic accuracy gains,", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 28
txt(CX1, y, "safety considerations, and the translational gap from research validation to bedside deployment", f_scope, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 55

# ============================================================
# 2. THE ANCHOR — <5%
# ============================================================
panel_h = 720
rect(CX1, y, CX2, y + panel_h, C_DARK)
rect(CX1, y, CX1 + 7, y + panel_h, C_GOLD)

ay = y + 45

t = "< 5 %"
aw = tw(t, f_anchor)
txt(CX1 + (CW - aw) // 2, ay, t, f_anchor, C_GOLD)
ay += 370

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "OF PUBLISHED AI MODELS HAVE UNDERGONE", f_anchor_lbl, C_TEXT)
ay += 40
txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "PROSPECTIVE CLINICAL VALIDATION", f_anchor_lbl, C_GOLD)
ay += 65

bx, bw, bh = CX1 + 180, CW - 360, 22
hbar(bx, ay, bw, bh, 0.05, C_GOLD, C_PANEL)
ay += 55

txt_c(CX1 + CW//2, ay, "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML devices (2023)   ·   >400 studies reviewed", f_mono, C_SUBTLE)

y += panel_h + 65

# ============================================================
# 3. SENSITIVITY — FULL WIDTH
# ============================================================
txt(CX1, y, "DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", f_section, C_TEAL)
y += 65

txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN DIAGNOSTIC SENSITIVITY — AI vs. CLINICIAN-ONLY WORKFLOWS", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
y += 55

# AI 87.5%
txt(CX1, y, "AI-ASSISTED", f_body, C_TEAL)
txt_r(CX2, y, "87.5%", f_big_num, C_TEAL)
y += 62
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 38, 0.875, C_TEAL)
y += 62

# Clinician 78.2%
txt(CX1, y, "CLINICIAN-ONLY", f_body, C_SUBTLE)
txt_r(CX2, y, "78.2%", f_big_num, C_SUBTLE)
y += 62
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 38, 0.782, C_MUTED)
y += 62

# Delta
apanel(CX1, y, CX1 + 460, y + 64, C_TEAL, 4)
txt(CX1 + 24, y + 10, "+9.3 pp", f_med_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 240, y + 18, "sensitivity gain", f_body_sm, C_SUBTLE)
y += 95

# Specificity
hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 30
txt(CX1, y, "MEDIAN SPECIFICITY", f_mono_bold, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 340, y, "AI  93.1%", f_sm_num, C_TEAL)
txt(CX1 + 560, y, "CLINICIAN  91.4%", f_sm_num, C_SUBTLE)
txt(CX1 + 900, y, "Δ +1.7 pp", f_body_sm, C_TEAL)
y += 44
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 14, 0.931, C_TEAL)
y += 20
hbar(CX1, y, CW, 14, 0.914, C_MUTED)
y += 45

hline(y, CX1, CX2, C_DIVIDER, 1)
y += 55

# ============================================================
# 4. TWO-COLUMN: DOMAIN TABLE + SAFETY
# ============================================================

# --- LEFT: DOMAIN TABLE ---
ly = y

txt(COL1_X1, ly, "PERFORMANCE BY", f_section, C_TEXT)
ly += 58
txt(COL1_X1, ly, "CLINICAL DOMAIN", f_section, C_TEAL)
ly += 70

cx = [COL1_X1, COL1_X1+270, COL1_X1+460, COL1_X1+650, COL1_X1+840]
for i, h in enumerate(["DOMAIN", "AI SENS", "CL SENS", "AI SPEC", "CL SPEC"]):
    txt(cx[i], ly, h, f_table_hd, C_SUBTLE)
ly += 34
hline(ly, COL1_X1, COL1_X1 + 1030, C_DIVIDER, 1)

domains = [
    ("Radiology",     "89.3%", "79.8%", "94.0%", "92.1%"),

apanel(COL1_X1, ly, COL1_X2, ly + 92, C_TEAL, 5)

# 18% panel
apanel(COL2_X1, ry, COL2_X2, ry + 350, C_WARN, 7)

ry += 52

# Evidential Form

Communication through the architecture of evidence itself. In this philosophy, every visual element is a datum made spatial — numbers become monuments, percentages become proportional territories, and the gaps between what is measured and what is absent become the most powerful spatial gestures. The canvas is a clinical landscape: precise, measured, and ruthlessly honest. Meticulously crafted compositions treat information as structural material, building meaning through the disciplined accumulation of geometric form rather than decorative excess. Every millimeter of whitespace is intentional, every alignment the product of painstaking calibration by a designer at the absolute peak of their discipline.

Space and form obey the logic of the evidence. Massive typographic figures anchor the visual field — single statistics rendered at architectural scale, their presence undeniable. Against these monuments, smaller notations and comparative marks create rhythm and context. The composition breathes through deliberate negative space, where emptiness itself carries weight: the unmeasured, the unvalidated, the absent data made visible through what surrounds it. Rectilinear panels and geometric zones divide the canvas with the authority of a laboratory protocol — each territory defined, nothing ambiguous. The result must appear as though it took countless hours of refinement, each spatial decision weighed against the whole until perfect equilibrium is achieved.

Color operates as a diagnostic instrument. A deep, authoritative ground — the slate of institutional architecture, the navy of scientific credibility — establishes intellectual gravity. Against this, a single clinical accent (teal, the color of calibrated measurement) marks confirmed findings and validated evidence. A second, warmer tone (muted gold) signals where attention must linger. A restrained warning hue appears only where the evidence demands alarm — never decorative, always purposeful. The palette is severely limited: four tones at most, each earning its place through function. This chromatic discipline, the product of deep expertise, ensures that color never decorates but always communicates.

Typography exists in two registers: the monumental and the annotative. The former — vast, confident numerals and spare headings — dominates the visual field and carries the argument's spine. The latter — thin, precise labels set in rationalist sans-serifs or disciplined serifs — provides the connective tissue, guiding the eye without competing for attention. Text is never explanatory; it is directional. A number does not need a sentence to justify its presence. A label does not need elaboration. The hierarchy is absolute and the craftsmanship impeccable — every letterform placed with the care reserved for specimens in a curated collection. Words are sparse, clinical, essential. The philosophy demands that a viewer could strip all text from the composition and still sense the argument through form alone.

Rhythm emerges from systematic repetition: aligned panels create visual cadence, comparative bars establish proportional dialogue, and gridded arrangements suggest the rigor of controlled experimentation. The overall composition reads top-to-bottom as a logical progression — from premise through evidence to implication — but each zone also holds independently, a self-contained visual argument. The final work must look as though it emerged from a discipline with centuries of tradition: the tradition of making invisible truths visible through painstaking, master-level visual orchestration. Nothing is improvised. Every element is the product of deep expertise and countless hours of careful, deliberate craft.

Communication through the architecture of evidence itself. The canvas is a clinical landscape: precise, measured, and ruthlessly honest. Meticulously crafted compositions treat information as structural material, building meaning through the disciplined accumulation of geometric form rather than decorative excess. Every millimeter of whitespace is intentional, every alignment the product of painstaking calibration by a designer at the absolute peak of their discipline.

Space and form obey the logic of the evidence. Massive typographic figures anchor the visual field — single statistics rendered at architectural scale, their presence undeniable. Against these monuments, smaller notations and comparative marks create rhythm and context. The composition breathes through deliberate negative space, where emptiness itself carries weight: the unmeasured, the unvalidated, the absent data made visible through what surrounds it. Rectilinear panels and geometric zones divide the canvas with the authority of a laboratory protocol — each territory defined, nothing ambiguous. The result must appear as though it took countless hours of refinement, each spatial decision weighed against the whole until perfect equilibrium is achieved.

Color operates as a diagnostic instrument. A deep, authoritative ground — the slate of institutional architecture, the navy of scientific credibility — establishes intellectual gravity. Against this, a single clinical accent (teal, the color of calibrated measurement) marks confirmed findings and validated evidence. A second, warmer tone (muted gold) signals where attention must linger. A restrained warning hue appears only where the evidence demands alarm — never decorative, always purposeful. The palette is severely limited: four tones at most, each earning its place through function. This chromatic discipline, the product of deep expertise, ensures that color never decorates but always communicates.

Typography exists in two registers: the monumental and the annotative. The former — vast, confident numerals and spare headings — dominates the visual field and carries the argument's spine. The latter — thin, precise labels set in rationalist sans-serifs or disciplined serifs — provides the connective tissue, guiding the eye without competing for attention. Text is never explanatory; it is directional. A number does not need a sentence to justify its presence. A label does not need elaboration. The hierarchy is absolute and the craftsmanship impeccable — every letterform placed with the care reserved for specimens in a curated collection. Words are sparse, clinical, essential. The philosophy demands that a viewer could strip all text from the composition and still sense the argument through form alone.

Rhythm emerges from systematic repetition: aligned panels create visual cadence, comparative bars establish proportional dialogue, and gridded arrangements suggest the rigor of controlled experimentation. The overall composition reads top-to-bottom as a logical progression — from premise through evidence to implication — but each zone also holds independently, a self-contained visual argument. The final work must look as though it emerged from a discipline with centuries of tradition: the tradition of making invisible truths visible through painstaking, master-level visual orchestration. Nothing is improvised. Every element is the product of deep expertise and countless hours of careful, deliberate craft.
